allies.clinicalActionEn: Downregulates pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-6, TNF-a) and protects vascular endothelial integrity.
allies.clinicalActionEs: Frena citocinas inflamatorias (IL-6, TNF-a) y protege el endotelio vascular.

allies.clinicalActionEn: Mimics insulin signaling to facilitate cellular glucose uptake without triggering hyperinsulinemia.
allies.clinicalActionEs: Facilita la entrada de glucosa en la célula sin disparar picos excesivos de insulina.

allies.clinicalActionEn: Stimulates digestive motility, prevents small intestinal bacterial overgrowth (SIBO), and enhances bile acid secretion.
allies.clinicalActionEs: Estimula el vaciado gástrico y previene el sobrecrecimiento bacteriano (SIBO).

allies.clinicalActionEn: Improves digestive comfort and feeds beneficial Akkermansia muciniphila strains in the colonic mucosa.
allies.clinicalActionEs: Favorece la flora protectora Akkermansia muciniphila en el colon.
